item.title: KPMG issues unqualified opinion on Tether's $180 billion USDT reserves in company's first full financial audit.
SEC cancels planned Reg Crypto proposal meeting, leaving crypto offering framework with no scheduled date.
MSCI opens consultation that could exclude bitcoin treasury companies from its global investable market indexes.
Harmony protocol confirms exploit minting 4 billion ONE tokens equal to 26% of supply; network considers rollback.
JPMorgan plans to accept Bitcoin and Ethereum as loan collateral held at approved third-party custodians.
FATF reports stablecoins composed 84% of $154 billion in illicit virtual asset transaction volume recorded in 2025.
CFTC chair confirms agency plans to finalize crypto ruleset independently of stalled congressional Clarity Act.
EU MiCA grace period expired July 1, requiring all crypto service providers to hold a valid regulatory license.
GENIUS Act stablecoin compliance framework awaits final implementing rules from OCC, FDIC, Fed, and Treasury.
FATF review finds 60% of jurisdictions with Travel Rule laws have yet to issue enforcement findings or directives.
Kraken launches CFTC-regulated Bitcoin perpetual futures for U.S. customers, among first onshore perp listings.
Augustus raises $180 million to build a federally chartered clearing bank for stablecoin-era payment settlement.
South Korea lowers the threshold for crypto Travel Rule obligations, expanding AML identification requirements.
CFTC Innovation Advisory Committee to meet August 20 to discuss crypto market structure and AI-related regulation.
